title: eval-harness: integrate prompt-regression metrics into CI gating and quality hooks
author: Asha Patel
description: Add a CI-integrated evaluation step that runs prompt-set regression checks and computes quality metrics used by gating hooks. Motivation: reduce silent regressions in prompt/response quality when model pins or infra changes are deployed; provide a deterministic pass/fail that can be configured per-release channel. This PR hooks the eval-harness metrics aggregator into the CI pipeline and exposes two gating modes: soft (comment + warn) and hard (fail build). Includes threshold config, per-prompt failure summaries, and a compact artifacts uploader for historical dashboards. Checklist: add CI job and workflow; implement metrics aggregator + serializer; add gating hook for GitHub actions; add unit and integration tests; document config and runbook. Notes: thresholds default to conservative values and are configurable via repo/.eval-config.yml. Related: ENG-4312 for rollout plan; QA-122 for test coverage matrix.
